citation: For conspicuous actions of valour during extended duty in the Capellan theatre during [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOpRAT],Operation RAT]], House Davion awards {COMPANY.CompanyName} the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDecoration_Davion_SunburstGold],Gold Sunburst]]. {COMPANY.CompanyName} served with distinction beyond the regular call of duty in the Battles of Liao, Genoa, Arboris and Woodstock, and their efforts in service to the Federated Suns will not soon be forgotten.
